messages.subject: Water butts are full
messages.preview: The rain last night filled every butt on the east side, so no need to carry cans this week. The tap by the shed stays off until spring.

messages.subject: Spare seed potatoes
messages.preview: I have two bags left from the order. First come, first served, they are in the green box by the gate.

messages.subject: Work day on Saturday
messages.preview: We clear the paths and turn the compost from ten. Bring gloves; tea and soup at one. If it pours we move to Sunday.

messages.subject: Lost secateurs
messages.preview: Red handles, left near plot 12. Please leave them on the shelf in the shed if you find them.
